_comment: Golden tests for the counter engine. Each asserts something that should stay true regardless of weight tuning. Assertion types: top (#1 must be champ), ranks_above (higher scores > lower), fires/not_fires (champ's fired rules include/exclude a rule id), confidence (scenario top-pick confidence), has_flag/lacks_flag (data-level guard, no scenario). 'scenario' is either a name from counter_scenarios.seed.json or an inline object. Only assert UNCONTROVERSIAL things — this file is the home for every lesson learned (see the 'GUARD' tests that lock in this session's corrections).
